courtyard_bridge_junction.detection: An interior north run with an exposed east wall immediately left, an exposed west wall immediately right, and empty floor cells above the run.
courtyard_bridge_junction.rim: Repaint the north run above both side walls and use ‘—, at the right termination.
courtyard_bridge_junction.side_wall_resolution: Terminate both inner vertical walls into the bridge and clear their lower cap glyphs beneath the rim.

one_sided_bridge_junction.detection: An interior north run with an exposed east wall immediately left, empty notch cells above, and an exposed east edge at the run’s rightmost floor section.
one_sided_bridge_junction.rim: Use the approved left half of the courtyard bridge rim and preserve the ordinary exterior east cap.
one_sided_bridge_junction.side_wall_resolution: Terminate the single inner east wall into the bridge and clear its lower cap beneath the hanging face.

mirrored_one_sided_bridge_junction.detection: An interior north run beginning at an exposed west edge, with empty notch cells above and an exposed west wall immediately right.
mirrored_one_sided_bridge_junction.rim: Preserve the ordinary exterior-west rim start and use the approved ‘—, curved termination at the inner west wall.
mirrored_one_sided_bridge_junction.side_wall_resolution: Terminate the single inner west wall into the bridge and clear its lower cap beneath the final slash.

horizontal_corridor_junction.detection: An interior north run with matching upper and lower east/west room walls, empty cells above and below the span, and a matching south run one row below.
horizontal_corridor_junction.north_rim: Join the two upper doorway walls using the approved curved right termination.
horizontal_corridor_junction.south_face: Keep the ordinary foreground south-wall treatment.
horizontal_corridor_junction.note: The corridor is topologically distinct from a courtyard even though the approved visual junction reuses the same hanging face motif.

vertical_corridor_junction.detection: Paired exposed west/east runs around one occupied column, continuous connections into rooms above and below, and matching room-wall segments around both doorway openings.
vertical_corridor_junction.west_wall: Foreground |/| run crossing the actor anchor.
vertical_corridor_junction.east_wall: Background |/| run beyond the centered actor anchor.
vertical_corridor_junction.actor_occlusion: The exposed west wall occludes every corridor section; the east wall does not.
vertical_corridor_junction.note: The current upper and lower doorway transitions remain literal and require visual approval.
